title: Little Orbit
challenge: A learning-toy startup founded by two teachers. On a loud toy shelf, its packaging shouted as hard as everything around it, and parents couldn’t tell it was different.
insight: In the aisle, parents choose for the child but buy with their own judgement. The pack had to reassure the adult and delight the child at the same time.
idea: A calm, curious identity built from simple shapes a child can name, with clear learning outcomes for parents on the back. The box opens into the first game, so the packaging becomes part of play.
outcome: A range that stands out in a loud aisle by being the calm one.
